what: ECR basic image scan (scan on push) of the deployed image
note: Findings count a CVE once per affected package. Every affected package is an Amazon Linux 2023 OS package of the AWS Lambda Python 3.12 base image (pinned by digest in the Dockerfile); none is in the packages the image adds (opencv-python-headless, numpy). Written by scripts/ecr_scan_summary.py from `aws ecr describe-image-scan-findings` for this tag.
